verdict.rationale: Runway's own docs show image-to-video generation: the video generator works "from text, an image or a clip," the API has an image-to-video mode, and Gen-4.5 needs an input image by default. Nothing in the pack shows that the subject and composition of the source image are kept in the output, and there is no hands-on test of image animation. Missing for 10: documented subject/composition fidelity for image-to-video, independent or hands-on corroboration of animation quality, and details on first-frame/reference conditioning controls.

support.subject: As a creator, I can animate a still image into motion with the subject and composition preserved
